spec: block 5 R-10 and Table C, CO-B5-02
purpose: Per `Id` answer for the Brazil readout: `class` (class_id), the collection and year it was computed against, and `area_ha` from the source polygon geometry.

build_meta.label: sidecar-area-only
build_meta.area_method: geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid (pyproj Geod), m2 / 10000
build_meta.area_source: the source polygon geometry of the parquet, not a tile fragment
build_meta.overlap_sample_note: One in every (rows/5000) row was sampled and tested for positive-area overlap. A shared pixel can only carry one polygon id, so an overlapping pair would split its pixels between two polygons.
build_meta.class_not_computed_reason: No MapBiomas Collection 11 2025 raster is reachable from this machine: the documented object brazil_coverage-col11_2025.tif answers 403 for anonymous callers and for the authenticated Google account, the MapBiomas download page says the map download is suspended, and no Google Cloud project here has the Earth Engine API enabled. class_id, collection and year are therefore NULL, not guessed; rerun this script with --raster once a local copy exists.

read_me: class_status says whether a class was computed. If it is not_computed, class_id, collection and year are NULL on every row and class_not_computed_reason in build_meta says why; the area_ha column is complete in either case.
